claim: The biggest long-running West End musicals still bookable in 2026 are The Lion King (Lyceum), Wicked (Apollo Victoria), Les Misérables (Sondheim), Hamilton (Victoria Palace), Mamma Mia! (Novello) and The Phantom of the Opera (His Majesty's).
quote: The Lion King is at the Lyceum Theatre; The Phantom of the Opera is at His Majesty's Theatre; Les Misérables is at the Sondheim Theatre; Wicked is at the Apollo Victoria Theatre; Mamma Mia! is at the Novello Theatre; and Hamilton is at the Victoria Palace Theatre.

claim: Notable 2026 West End openings include Paddington The Musical at the Savoy, Avenue Q at the Shaftesbury, Kinky Boots at the London Coliseum, Beetlejuice at the Prince Edward, Jesus Christ Superstar at the Palladium and Sinatra The Musical at the Aldwych from June 2026.
quote: Big new musicals now playing in London in 2026 include Paddington The Musical at the Savoy Theatre; Avenue Q at the Shaftesbury Theatre; and Kinky Boots The Musical at the London Coliseum.

claim: Cynthia Erivo stars as 23 roles in Dracula at the Noël Coward Theatre, running 4 February – 31 May 2026, a 1h50 no-interval Kip Williams cine-theatre adaptation.
quote: Dracula runs from 4 Feb – 31 May 2026 at the Noel Coward Theatre. Cynthia Erivo plays 23 roles, approximately 1 hour 50 mins with no interval.

claim: Shakespeare's Globe summer 2026 season runs A Midsummer Night's Dream (Apr 23–Aug 29), Mother Courage (May 7–Jun 27) with Michelle Terry, Much Ado About Nothing (Jun 11–Oct 24), Love's Labour's Lost (Jul 17–Sep 13) and As You Like It (Aug 14–Oct 25), with £5 standing tickets every show.
quote: A Midsummer Night's Dream runs April 23 to August 29... Much Ado About Nothing Jun 11-Oct 24... Love's Labour's Lost Jul 17-Sep 13... As You Like It Aug 14-Oct 25. Tickets include £5 standing tickets for each show.

claim: National Theatre's 2026 lineup includes Les Liaisons Dangereuses with Lesley Manville and Aidan Turner (until 6 Jun), War Horse returning (until 30 Jul), Pride The Musical (11 Jun–12 Sep), The Misanthrope with Sandra Oh, and Electra/Persona with Cate Blanchett.
quote: Les Liaisons Dangereuses – Marianne Elliott directs Lesley Manville and Aidan Turner... running until 6 June 2026. War Horse... running until 30 July 2026. Pride – A new musical adaptation... running 11 June–12 September 2026.

claim: The Donmar Warehouse 2026 season presents Mass by Fran Kranz (Carrie Cracknell directs), The Guilty by Chloë Moss with Russell Tovey, a revival of A Month in the Country, and the world premiere of Ilford Boy.
quote: The Donmar Warehouse is presenting three world premieres and a major revival in 2026: Mass... The Guilty... A Month in the Country... Ilford Boy.

claim: The Bridge Theatre's award-winning Into The Woods (Sondheim/Lapine) with Kate Fleetwood transfers to the Noël Coward Theatre opening 7 October 2026.
quote: The Bridge Theatre's multi-award-winning production of Stephen Sondheim and James Lapine's Into The Woods, with Kate Fleetwood reprising her role as the Witch, will transfer to the West End at the Noël Coward Theatre, opening 7 October 2026.

claim: The Royal Ballet & Opera 2026 spring season at Covent Garden includes Giselle (Jan 17–Feb 13), a Wayne McGregor mixed programme (Feb 14–Mar 20), and his Woolf Works triptych (Apr 18–May 6), plus Puccini's Turandot, with tickets from £9.
quote: Giselle... January 17 – February 13, 2026... Wayne McGregor's award-winning triptych... April 18 – May 6, 2026. Tickets start at just £9.

claim: BBC Proms 2026 runs 14 July to 12 September at the Royal Albert Hall with 86 concerts (72 at the Hall), opening with Yunchan Lim playing Ravel under Dalia Stasevska on 17 July.
quote: BBC Proms 2026 runs from Friday 14 July to Saturday 9 September. This year's BBC Proms features 86 concerts, 72 at London's Royal Albert Hall. The First Night of the Proms (17 July) features the BBC Symphony Orchestra... pianist Yunchan Lim performing Ravel's Piano Concerto in G Major.

claim: The O2 Arena's late spring/summer 2026 calendar includes Doja Cat (29 May), Madison Beer (30 May), TWICE (3–4 Jun), Dermot Kennedy (5 Jun), FKA twigs (10 Jun), Olivia Dean (12 Jun), Lily Allen (27–28 Jun, 7 Jul) and Def Leppard with Extreme (2 Jul).
quote: Doja Cat on May 29, 2026; Madison Beer performing the locket tour on May 30, 2026; TWICE performing on June 3-4, 2026; Dermot Kennedy on June 5, 2026; FKA twigs on June 10, 2026; Olivia Dean on June 12, 2026.

claim: TKTS, the official Society of London Theatre booth in Leicester Square's Clocktower, sells same-day and up-to-a-week-ahead West End tickets at discounts up to 50%, open Mon–Sat 10.30am–6pm and Sun 11am–4pm, with online sales mirroring booth stock from 12.01am daily.
quote: Monday – Saturday from 10.30am – 6pm & from 11am – 4pm on Sundays. The Official London Theatre Ticket Booth is the only not-for-profit ticket booth run by the Society of London Theatre.

claim: For app-based discounts beyond TKTS, TodayTix is the leading mobile option for lottery and rush West End seats, alongside restricted-view seats and official theatre lotteries.
quote: If you're serious about scoring cheap West End tickets, TodayTix is the app you need on your phone.
